display_name: Kubernetes clusters should not allow container privilege escalation
rationale: Keep 7.*.* until v8 behavior is explicitly tested. The APF effect=Deny remains valid, but v8 changes the Gatekeeper template and introduces a new behavior parameter.
change_summary: Adds Boolean parameter forcePrivilegeEscalationToBeFalse with default false.
Changes the public Gatekeeper template reference from v3 to v4.
Removes lowercase effect aliases; canonical Audit, Deny and Disabled remain.
Keeps the same built-in policy definition ID.
